messages.subject: Plot geom_freqpoly on coord_polar
parts:
Is it possible to plot a frequency polygon on a polar coordinate plot?

If I have a data set where observations are made at various angles (0 to 360 degrees) and I want to plot those instances how would I set up the code?

example data:

ex_data1 <- rnorm(200, mean = 180, sd = 60)

Thanks in advance,

Art

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Plot geom_freqpoly on coord_polar
parts:
Art, did you tried this?

ex_data1 <- data.frame(x = rnorm(200, mean = 180, sd = 60))

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(ex_data1, aes(x = x)) + geom_freqpoly() + coord_polar()

HTH
Luciano
